text: It's a small indie called Mary Poppins.
zh: 这是一部叫《欢乐满人间》的小众独立片。
zh_hant: 這是一部叫《歡樂滿人間》的小眾獨立片。

text: I went to visit her all the time.
I was shooting something else, but I went almost every weekend.
zh: 当时我在拍别的，但几乎每个周末都去。
zh_hant: 當時我在拍別的，但幾乎每個週末都去。

text: You got to get through custom-made things.
zh: 你得穿过那些定制的东西。
zh_hant: 你得穿過那些定製的東西。

text: And then I hit this guy who's about my age, and he looked like he was ready to get a little surly with me.
zh: 然后我碰到一个跟我差不多年纪的家伙，他看起来有点想跟我发火。
zh_hant: 然後我碰到一個跟我差不多年紀的傢伙，他看起來有點想跟我發火。

text: And he said, "Says here that you're an actor."
zh: 他说：“这上面写你是个演员。”
zh_hant: 他說：“這上面寫你是個演員。”

text: And I said, "Yeah."
And he said, "Would I know you from anything?"
zh: 他说：“我认识你吗？从什么作品里？”
zh_hant: 他說：“我認識你嗎？從什麼作品裡？”

text: I went, we redid the U.K. version of The Office.
zh: 我说，我们重拍了英国版的《办公室》。
zh_hant: 我說，我們重拍了英國版的《辦公室》。

text: Strike one.
He was like, oh, "I hated that version."
zh: 他好像说：“哦，我讨厌那个版本。”
zh_hant: 他好像說：“哦，我討厭那個版本。”

text: "Oh, you took what we did perfect."
zh: “哦，你把我们做得很完美的东西毁了。”
zh_hant: “哦，你把我們做得很完美的東西毀了。”

text: And then I said, yeah.
I said, my wife.
And he says, is she an actress?
And I said, yeah.
He said, would I know her?
And I go, I don't know, man.
Her name's Emily Blunt.
And he goes, he goes, you?
And I went, yeah.
And he goes, you?
You married Emily Blunt.
And I go, yeah.
And he goes like this.
Okay.
Let's go.
